top_stories.title: AI plagiarised research that passed checks meant to spot it - then I recognised it was my work
top_stories.summary: A researcher recounts discovering that AI-generated content had plagiarised their own published work, passing through detection systems designed to catch such copying. The case highlights fundamental weaknesses in AI plagiarism detection tools and raises serious questions about research integrity in academic publishing. The incident underscores growing concerns about generative AI's impact on scholarly work and intellectual property.

top_stories.title: The AI code wars are heating up
top_stories.summary: The Verge examines the intensifying competition between OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic in the AI coding tools market, analysing the strategic moves each company is making to capture developer mindshare. The piece details how AI-assisted coding has become a critical battleground for the major AI labs, with significant product updates and pricing battles emerging. The race has major implications for software development workflows and enterprise adoption of AI tools.

top_stories.title: European AI. A playbook to own it
top_stories.summary: Mistral AI has published a strategic manifesto laying out a vision for European AI leadership, outlining the company's philosophy and approach to building sovereign, competitive AI infrastructure on the continent. The document positions Mistral as a distinctly European alternative to US and Chinese AI dominance, with arguments for why Europe must develop its own AI capabilities. It arrives at a pivotal moment for European AI policy and industrial strategy.

top_stories.title: Xero & Anthropic fuel AI battle in finance software
top_stories.summary: Accounting software provider Xero has partnered with Anthropic to integrate advanced AI capabilities into its finance platform, marking a significant move in the competitive enterprise AI market. The collaboration signals growing demand for AI-powered tools in financial software and represents another major enterprise deployment of Anthropic's Claude models. The deal intensifies competition among cloud-based accounting and business software providers.

top_stories.title: How Grok 3 compares to ChatGPT, DeepSeek and other AI rivals
top_stories.summary: A comparative analysis examines xAI's Grok 3 model against leading competitors including ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and other major large language models across a range of capability benchmarks. The piece provides a detailed breakdown of where each model excels and falls short, offering practical guidance for users and businesses evaluating AI tools. The comparison arrives amid intensifying competition at the frontier of AI model development.

further_links.title: AI Will Be Met with Violence, and Nothing Good Will Come of It
further_links.summary: The Algorithmic Bridge argues that rising public anger toward AI is producing a dangerous climate of violence and warns that neither side of the debate will benefit from the escalating tensions.

further_links.title: Why AI Sucks at Front End
further_links.summary: A technical analysis examines why AI coding assistants consistently underperform on front-end web development tasks, exploring the structural reasons these tools struggle with UI and design-oriented code.

further_links.title: Apple's accidental moat: How the 'AI Loser' may end up winning
further_links.summary: A Substack analysis argues that Apple's cautious, privacy-first approach to AI may paradoxically position it to win long-term, even as it currently trails competitors on generative AI features.

further_links.title: Tech valuations are back to pre-AI boom levels
further_links.summary: Apollo's daily analysis finds that technology sector valuations have retreated to levels seen before the AI investment boom, raising questions about the sustainability of AI-driven market enthusiasm.

further_links.title: Show HN: Hormuz Havoc, a satirical game that got overrun by AI bots in 24 hours
further_links.summary: A developer launched a satirical web game that was rapidly taken over by AI bots within 24 hours of going live, illustrating the challenge of maintaining human-only digital spaces in the age of autonomous agents.

further_links.title: Launch HN: Twill.ai (YC S25) – Delegate to cloud agents, get back PRs
further_links.summary: Y Combinator-backed Twill.ai has launched a platform allowing developers to delegate coding tasks to cloud-based AI agents, which return completed pull requests rather than just code suggestions.

further_links.title: Physical AI Devices to Reach 145 Million Units Over Next Decade
further_links.summary: Counterpoint Research forecasts that physical AI-enabled devices will surge to 145 million units by 2035, driven by robotics, autonomous vehicles, and embedded AI hardware across consumer and industrial sectors.

further_links.title: OpenAI backs Illinois bill that would limit when AI labs can be held liable
further_links.summary: OpenAI is supporting an Illinois bill that would restrict the circumstances under which AI companies can face legal liability for harms caused by their models.

further_links.title: xAI prepares credits system for upcoming Grok Build launch
further_links.summary: Elon Musk's xAI is developing a credits-based billing system ahead of the launch of Grok Build, its developer-facing platform for building applications on top of the Grok model.

further_links.title: US summons bank bosses over cyber risks from Anthropic's latest AI model
further_links.summary: US authorities have summoned senior banking executives to discuss cybersecurity risks posed by Anthropic's latest AI model, signalling growing regulatory concern about AI deployment in critical financial infrastructure.
